negative_prompt: excessive sharpening halos, artificial portrait-mask edges, implausible optical bokeh, heavy studio stylization, watermark, signature

name: 长曝光摄影
prompt: long-exposure photograph of {prompt}, stable stationary structures, physically coherent motion trails, continuous exposure behavior, controlled highlight accumulation, realistic movement blur, balanced ambient exposure
negative_prompt: camera shake on stationary objects, disconnected light trails, random ghost duplicates, clipped light streaks, inconsistent motion direction, watermark, signature

name: 霓虹黑色电影
prompt: neon noir interpretation of {prompt}, motivated colored practical lighting, low-key exposure, controlled luminous reflections, graphic shadow structure, restrained cinematic grading, tense nocturnal atmosphere
negative_prompt: automatic rain additions, excessive neon signage, crushed shadows, indiscriminate bloom, unrelated lens flares, watermark, signature

name: 剪影艺术
prompt: silhouette artwork of {prompt}, solid clearly defined shape masses, strong figure-ground contrast, precise negative spaces, readable overlapping forms, economical internal detail, graphic simplicity
negative_prompt: unnecessary interior shading, unclear contour intersections, excessive texture, weak background separation, watermark, signature

name: 移轴摄影
prompt: tilt-shift miniature-effect photograph of {prompt}, elevated viewpoint where appropriate, narrow plane of sharp focus, gradual optical defocus, believable miniature scale cues, precise central details
negative_prompt: uniform full-frame blur, abrupt blur-mask boundaries, inconsistent focal plane, excessive saturation, warped geometry, watermark, signature
